claims.claim: The latest published study-plan guide is the 5th edition (13 Oct 2025); no 1448-specific edition is listed.
The MoE study-plans page points to iEN for viewing the course textbooks, i.e. iEN is the Ministry-endorsed public source for the books.
Textbooks for 1448 on iEN are published as parts («الجزء الأول / الثاني من المقرر»); the books themselves do not state which term each part belongs to.

conclusions: 1448 has two terms (verified). Per-subject term membership: for subjects whose book is split into two parts, term = inferred (part n → term n); for single-book courses (many secondary track courses) the term is unknown until an official distribution is found. Nothing is marked 'verified' per term. Madrasati (login) was not used.
